mcps.name: Dinah Orchestration
mcps.description: Least-privilege agent coordination: staffing, tasks, progress, blockers, help, and messages.

tools.name: provision_agent
tools.description: Provision an active specialist; authorized only for HR.

tools.name: create_task
tools.description: Create and optionally dispatch tracked work with acceptance criteria and dependencies.

tools.name: ask_user
tools.description: Pause and ask the user a question. Options array empty = free text; non-empty = MCQ radio options plus free text.

tools.name: inform_user
tools.description: Inform the user without pausing. Chat-only, never agent-to-agent traffic.

tools.name: create_project
tools.description: Create a project as CEO and provision its default Manager Bard.

tools.name: send_agent_message
tools.description: Accept a direct message into the durable queue.

tools.name: claim_message
tools.description: Claim a delivery with a lease.

tools.name: fail_message
tools.description: Fail and optionally retry a delivery.

tools.name: release_message
tools.description: Release a delivery back to the queue.

mcps.name: io.github.arifulislamat/database-mcp-sqlite
mcps.description: MCP server for SQLite databases. Read-only by default, row caps, statement timeouts.
